<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="COUNTER_WIDTH">4</parameter>
        <parameter id="IDLE">4'b0000</parameter>
        <parameter id="RECEIVE">4'b0001</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">4'b0010</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[COUNTER_WIDTH-1:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of serial input data bits received.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data register.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_valid">Valid signal for the output data.</reg>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal.</always>
            <if condition="!rst_n">If reset signal is active low, initialize the counter, output data, and valid signal.</if>
                <assign value="0">Initialize cnt to 0.</assign>
                <assign value="0">Initialize dout_parallel to 0.</assign>
                <assign value="0">Initialize dout_valid to 0.</assign>
            <else>Else, update the counter and output data based on the input data and valid signal.</else>
                <if condition="din_valid && (cnt == COUNTER_WIDTH-1)">If the input data is valid and the counter has reached its maximum value, set the valid signal to 1 and output the parallel data.</if>
                    <assign value="1">Set dout_valid to 1.</assign>
                    <assign value="{din_serial, dout_parallel[7:1]}">Shift the input data into the first position of the parallel data register.</assign>
                <else>Otherwise, increment the counter and store the input data in the corresponding position of the parallel data register.</else>
                    <assign value="cnt + 1">Increment cnt by 1.</assign>
                    <assign value="{dout_parallel[6:0], din_serial}">Store the input data in the next position of the parallel data register.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements the serial-to-parallel conversion circuit using sequential logic.</implementation>
</module>
